About

A French ensemble led by vocalist Rébecca M'Boungou, singing in French, English and Lingala. Drawing on the roots of Black music, Kolinga balances emotional depth with groove, rhythm and trance.

Highlights

  • Vocals in French, English and Lingala
  • Rébecca M'Boungou (vocals), Arnaud Estor (guitar), Jérôme Martineau-Ricotti (drums), Nico Martin (bass), Jérémie Poirier-Quinot (keys, flute), Vianney Desplantes (euphonium, flugabone)
